title: Me and AI competed to build Tetris for a YouTube video. I need you to select the winner.
author: IndependenceOk3130
selftext:
You can play both versions and select the winner from this link:  
[https://tetris.megapunch.live/](https://tetris.megapunch.live/)

Thanks for helping out. Also, I might feature some comments in the video too. If you don't want to show your username, just lmk.

comments.author: Duane_Winger
comments.body: I really don't like either, but the left is better.

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: The one on the left is much better.

comments.author: autoprime-jft007
comments.body: The one on the right looks better to me tbh, but the left has better accessibility.

comments.author: ItIsMooSe
comments.body:
Both lack what the other one has.
Left: what score do I have?
Right: what are the controlls?

comments.author: poponis
comments.body: None. This game is a clone. The winner is the original one.

comments.author: Hyperreals_
comments.body: right looks a bit better, but it doesn't have saving blocks so automatically much worse

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
Left.

The right one  is missing a number of QOL features. The most annoying is that the blocks don't properly rotate (or at least some types don't) where they shift around in space depending on which direction you swapped them to. That was  probably the most annoying aspect. Neither presents a proper challenge though as they don't seem to speed up. I like the aesthetic of the dark mode, and the colors of placed blocks are less distracting. You don't need full colors for them when you don't get any kind of benefit for utilizing colored areas later.

comments.author: maezrrackham
comments.body: Both are fine. I got annoyed by the light one's lack of sound and grid lines. Both are well within the ability of AI to make, but the dark one felt more AI

comments.author: dsdt
comments.body: gameplay wise ai wins this one. it is not a good approach like you have to press downwards 15 times to put a piece down real fast... the left one wins. right one looks like noctua + mirrors edge made a tetris game

replies.author: IndependenceOk3130
replies.body: Thanks for trying it out. Actually the controls are the same for both versions except for counter clockwise rotation. You can use Spacebar to hard drop the piece.

replies.author: dsdt
replies.body: then both are playable in my opinion, you need a tutorial or a controls chart easily available

comments.author: Kalaminator
comments.body: Ask it to add the chance to hold a piece that you can swap later. I did this, it is pretty basic.

comments.author: SillyYou8433
comments.body: Design of the left was better. For some reason, it felt the game on the right played better
